title: いつも僕を見下してくる可愛いけど生意気な後輩と出張先で一晩一緒に過ごしたら…何度もチ●ポ欲しがってきた！ 村上悠華
maker: エスワン ナンバーワンスタイル
label: S1 NO.1 STYLE
synopsis: “Even some random bird around here has a smarter brain than you, senpai! Are you an idiot!” Foul-mouthed, full of attitude, and despite being a new hire she does nothing but talk back—somehow I end up sharing a room with this cocky junior. After work drinks make her even drunker, and before I know it she’s dead asleep. Glancing at her sleeping form, her yukata has slipped open, exposing her erotic body. I take her as payback—then the next morning the tables turn on me… Murakamiyuka 「」
